_comment: Every assumption the harness carries, stated absolutely. If the application's
defaults change, this file does NOT follow silently: the gate passes these values
explicitly on every run via URL parameters, so a divergence between harness and
application defaults cannot change what is measured.
Waypoint slider positions are resolved by NAME through the shipped
data/derived/events.json at gate time, and the resolved numeric s is recorded in
each capture's probe. The names are absolute; the numbers are derived data.
Re-verify this file whenever a feature is added (see harness/run.py assumptions-check).

camera._altitude_note: 25 deg, not 0: the fork-5 nebula axis is scene z, and a camera looking straight down that axis can never frame the declared equatorial waist (critic round 2, NOT-MET 8)
